title: 我的邻居
content: 我家旁边住着一位阿姨。她很热情，也很聪明。我们是好邻居。她喜欢在花园里种草和花，环境很干净。有时她请我去她家做客，给我做蛋糕。她做的蛋糕特别甜，我很喜欢。
content_pinyin: wǒ jiā páng biān zhù zhe yī wèi ā yí 。 tā hěn rè qíng ， yě hěn cōng míng 。 wǒ men shì hǎo lín jū 。 tā xǐ huan zài huā yuán lǐ zhǒng cǎo hé huā ， huán jìng hěn gān jìng 。 yǒu shí tā qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā zuò kè ， gěi wǒ zuò dàn gāo 。 tā zuò de dàn gāo tè bié tián ， wǒ hěn xǐ huan 。
translation: An auntie lives next to my home. She is warm and also clever. We are good neighbors. She likes to grow grass and flowers in the garden; the environment is very clean. Sometimes she invites me to her home as a guest and makes me cake. The cake she makes is especially sweet, and I like it very much.

title: 锻炼身体
content: 为了健康，我决定每天锻炼。以前我总是很累，不想运动。现在我每天早上去公园跑步，有时骑自行车。虽然开始的时候很难，但是我一直坚持。一个月以后，我的身体好多了，也不容易感冒了。
content_pinyin: wèi le jiàn kāng ， wǒ jué dìng měi tiān duàn liàn 。 yǐ qián wǒ zǒng shì hěn lèi ， bù xiǎng yùn dòng 。 xiàn zài wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qù gōng yuán pǎo bù ， yǒu shí qí zì xíng chē 。 suī rán kāi shǐ de shí hou hěn nán ， dàn shì wǒ yì zhí jiān chí 。 yī gè yuè yǐ hòu ， wǒ de shēn tǐ hǎo duō le ， yě bù róng yì gǎn mào le 。
translation: For my health, I decided to exercise every day. Before, I was always tired and did not want to exercise. Now I go running in the park every morning, and sometimes ride a bike. Although it was hard at the beginning, I kept at it the whole time. After a month, my body was much better, and I no longer catch colds easily.

title: 一次旅游
content: 去年夏天，我和同事们一起去南方旅游。我们坐高铁出发，又方便又快。那个城市很漂亮，有山也有海。我们尝了很多特别的菜，还买了礼物。虽然有点儿累，但是大家都很开心。这次旅游我一直记得。
content_pinyin: qù nián xià tiān ， wǒ hé tóng shì men yì qǐ qù nán fāng lǚ yóu 。 wǒ men zuò gāo tiě chū fā ， yòu fāng biàn yòu kuài 。 nà ge chéng shì hěn piào liang ， yǒu shān yě yǒu hǎi 。 wǒ men cháng le hěn duō tè bié de cài ， hái mǎi le lǐ wù 。 suī rán yǒu diǎn r lèi ， dàn shì dà jiā dōu hěn kāi xīn 。 zhè cì lǚ yóu wǒ yì zhí jì de 。
translation: Last summer, my colleagues and I traveled to the south together. We set out by high-speed train, which was both convenient and fast. That city was very pretty, with mountains and the sea. We tasted many special dishes and also bought gifts. Although it was a bit tiring, everyone was happy. I still remember this trip.

title: 在图书馆
content: 我们学校有一个很大的图书馆，环境很安静。除了看书，我还常常在那里做作业、复习。上个星期我要参加一个重要的考试，所以每天都去图书馆练习。如果遇到难题，我就问同学。最后我的成绩不错，非常高兴。
content_pinyin: wǒ men xué xiào yǒu yī gè hěn dà de tú shū guǎn ， huán jìng hěn ān jìng 。 chú le kàn shū ， wǒ hái cháng cháng zài nà lǐ zuò zuò yè 、 fù xí 。 shàng gè xīng qī wǒ yào cān jiā yī gè zhòng yào de kǎo shì ， suǒ yǐ měi tiān dōu qù tú shū guǎn liàn xí 。 rú guǒ yù dào nán tí ， wǒ jiù wèn tóng xué 。 zuì hòu wǒ de chéng jì bú cuò ， fēi cháng gāo xìng 。
translation: Our school has a big library with a very quiet environment. Besides reading, I often do homework and review there. Last week I had to take an important exam, so I went to the library every day to practice. If I ran into a hard problem, I asked a classmate. In the end my result was not bad, and I was very happy.

title: 网上买东西
content: 现在很多人喜欢在网上买东西，又方便又便宜。上个月我在网上买了一个新手机。我用银行卡买，第二天东西就到了。如果不满意，还可以换。不过我觉得，有的东西还是去商店买比较好，因为可以先看清楚。
content_pinyin: xiàn zài hěn duō rén xǐ huan zài wǎng shang mǎi dōng xi ， yòu fāng biàn yòu pián yi 。 shàng gè yuè wǒ zài wǎng shang mǎi le yī gè xīn shǒu jī 。 wǒ yòng yín háng kǎ mǎi ， dì èr tiān dōng xi jiù dào le 。 rú guǒ bù mǎn yì ， hái kě yǐ huàn 。 bù guò wǒ jué de ， yǒu de dōng xi hái shi qù shāng diàn mǎi bǐ jiào hǎo ， yīn wèi kě yǐ xiān kàn qīng chu 。
translation: Now many people like to shop online — it is convenient and cheap. Last month I bought a new phone online. I paid by bank card, and the item arrived the next day. If you are not satisfied, you can also exchange it. However, I think for some things it is better to go to a shop, because you can see them clearly first.

title: 我的习惯
content: 我有一个好习惯：每天早上早起。起床以后，我先打扫房间，然后吃早饭。我觉得干净的环境让人舒服。晚上睡觉以前，我一般会看一会儿书，再准备好明天要用的东西。这样的生活让我觉得很健康。
content_pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī gè hǎo xí guàn ： měi tiān zǎo shang zǎo qǐ 。 qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu ， wǒ xiān dǎ sǎo fáng jiān ， rán hòu chī zǎo fàn 。 wǒ jué de gān jìng de huán jìng ràng rén shū fu 。 wǎn shang shuì jiào yǐ qián ， wǒ yì bān huì kàn yí huì r shū ， zài zhǔn bèi hǎo míng tiān yào yòng de dōng xi 。 zhè yàng de shēng huó ràng wǒ jué de hěn jiàn kāng 。
translation: I have a good habit: getting up early every morning. After getting up, I first tidy my room, then eat breakfast. I think a clean environment makes people comfortable. Before sleeping at night, I usually read for a while, then get ready the things I will need tomorrow. This kind of life makes me feel very healthy.
